notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly 1 damage to Boros Reckoner.
You have a way to give Boros Reckoner indestructible.
description:
Give Boros Reckoner indestructible, if needed, and then deal exactly 1 damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner and Ghyrson Starn trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 2 damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Boros Reckoner trigger from step 2, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Repeat from step 2.
